limits: Finite source composition only; no broad P0-P7 closure, whole-language soundness or backend refinement proof.

Scalar host LLVM ABI only; no arbitrary pointer/provenance, callback, thread, escaping stored lifetime or asynchronous cancellation qualification.
Requested payload ledgers and two allocator observations are not RSS or a process-memory bound.
Source records cover actual sparse materializations, not execution access to all 7699 tracked files.
No default route/production authority change; optimization_policy remains no_change; final349 is registration until separately executed.

static_review: Prune closes over hidden borrow_parents before CFG interfaces; new_block retains atomic aliases and renames loan atoms.
CFG edges preserve parent keys and existing resource alias/consumption checks; stored origins cannot vary silently across paths.
Shared aliases retain both parent and child until their last lexical binding; reverse cleanup ends child before parent.
Exclusive move transfers and clears the parent list; explicit drop consumes child/parent and early returns still require explicit exclusive cleanup.
Returned-call adapter is explicit v8, nonextern, one same-mode byte formal identified by return_origin, scalar extra arguments, direct named byte place, exactly one argument parent and child.
Existing source checker, ResourceIR, Core checker, Rust Machine, LLVM backend and production authority routes are unchanged by this slice.
